summary: Scope reduction and surviving-rival investigation from merged #731. Read materialized AQUINAS-ST-I-Q4-A2, AQUINAS-ST-I-Q6-A2, AQUINAS-ST-I-Q44-A1 in full, plus pinned q.104 a.1/q.105 a.5 translations. Proved that naming, reduced-description naming and goodness need transfer only for independently characterized universal esse sources and distinct effects; genus at esse supplies the condition before naming. Exact residual scope decomposition and populated strict separator are certified. The secondary-only rival jointly satisfies genus, strict causal ascent, actuality-to-being, formal/eminent preexistence, a universal existential maximum with no distinct incoming esse cause, and active particular/secondary causes while denying even the narrower transfer. Therefore existence dependence plus possession of perfections does not entail causal responsibility under that background. Sources support participation/concurrence but do not state the unrestricted legacy premise or identify every universal esse source with their divine first agent. Rejected: using already named divine concurrence to name the witness; identifying generation with sustaining esse; treating enablement or preexistence as production; attributing denial to Papineau/Hume or the unsourced Durandus label. Semantic grounding, exact locators, comparisons and remaining gaps: docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md. Legacy Challenges and route selection preserved; a sufficient narrower interface is not philosophical closure. Exact frontier effect: all ten legacy route costs, premise counts and open-premise sets unchanged, designated 40/38. Registration changes the legacy target to conditionally proved but unestablished; the global open-item list is 63 to 62, while target remains a route leaf and both narrower/residual obligations remain unestablished. This is classification, not discharge. Direct scope implication is detector-classified as a transcription; only the exact mathematical decomposition and model facts become established.
blocker: Independent defense of universal transfer: show why a source of every being’s esse actively causes each particular actuality, through or alongside secondary agents, rather than merely making its bearer and powers possible. Identifying the selected witness with q.44/q.105’s subsistent first cause needs additional defended structure; universal esse scope alone does not prove it.
